title: Saltburn
description: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.

title: Midsommar
description: A young American couple, their relationship foundering, travel to a Swedish midsummer festival where a seemingly pastoral paradise transforms into a sinister, dread-soaked nightmare as the locals reveal their terrifying agenda.

title: The Soul of America
description: Writer, journalist, historian and presidential biographer Jon Meacham offers his timely and invaluable insights into the United States' current political and historical moment by examining its past struggles with racism, sexism and xenophobia.

title: We Stand Alone Together: The Men of Easy Company
description: In 1943, U.S. troops ship out to engage in combat behind enemy lines during World War II.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E01 — Currahee
A rivalry blazes between Lt. Sobel and a junior officer who has earned the respect of the men in Easy Company.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E02 — Day of Days
Thousands of paratroopers cross the English Channel to France on D-Day; Lt. Winters leads an attack on a fortified German artillery position.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E03 — Carentan
Easy Company sustains casualties while waging battle in Normandy; Pvt. Blithe has trouble adjusting to combat; the company returns to England.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E04 — Replacements
A fresh group of paratroopers joins Easy Company shortly before it parachutes into German-occupied Holland; the company has to retreat when it meets a superior force.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E05 — Crossroads
Winters leads a dangerous mission on a Dutch dike; although ill-equipped, Easy Company races to help hold the Allied line in the Ardennes Forest.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E06 — Bastogne
Easy Company spends Christmas in the trenches while trying to hold the line in the forest outside Bastogne, Belgium.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E07 — The Breaking Point
After taking Bastogne, Belgium, the company moves on to the town of Foy, where many lives are lost as a result of Lt. Dike's incompetence.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E08 — The Last Patrol
Lt. Jones leads a patrol across a river to take enemy prisoners, but the loss of a paratrooper leads Winters to refuse to send another patrol the next night.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E09 — Why We Fight
Easy Company enters Germany and discovers an abandoned Nazi concentration camp occupied by emaciated prisoners, just as the local citizens learn that Hitler is dead.

title: Band of Brothers
description:
S01 E10 — Points
After capturing Eagle's Nest, Hitler's mountaintop fortress, the men of Easy Company face deployment to the Pacific.

title: Taken 2
description: Taken hostage with his wife in Istanbul, retired CIA agent Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson) enlists his daughter's (Maggie Grace) aid in helping him escape, then uses his particular set of skills to exact revenge on the kidnappers.

title: Evil Dead Rise
description: A reunion between two estranged sisters gets cut short by the rise of flesh-possessing demons, thrusting them into a primal battle for survival as they face the most nightmarish version of family imaginable.

title: Weapons
description: When all but one child from the same classroom mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

title: To Be Announced
description: Programming to be announced.

title: Fuze
description: London undergoes a citywide evacuation when a World War II bomb is unearthed at a construction site. Amid the escalating chaos, a daring criminal operation is set in motion -- one that uses the evacuation as a cover for a meticulously planned heist.

title: The Welcome Table
description: Investigation into the impact of the ecological disaster on everyday people's lives by looking at the intersection of climate and immigration.

title: Batman Returns
description: The Caped Crusader (Michael Keaton) clashes with Catwoman (Michelle Pfeiffer) and saves gloomy Gotham City from the foul Penguin's (Danny DeVito) plot.

title: One Battle After Another
description: Bob is a washed-up revolutionary who lives in a state of paranoia, surviving off-grid with his daughter, Willa. When his nemesis resurfaces and Willa goes missing, the former radical scrambles to find her while battling the consequences of his past.

title: Speed
description: A SWAT team ace (Keanu Reeves) must keep the speed of a Santa Monica bus above 50 mph, or a madman's (Dennis Hopper) bomb will explode.

title: Knock Knock
description: Two nubile, stranded women reveal a sinister agenda after they spend the night with a married architect.

title: Mother Mary
description: Preparing a comeback, the reunion between a pop icon and the legendary stylist she betrayed spirals into a supernatural reckoning.

title: Marc by Sofia
description: Sofia Coppola captures the genius and singular universe of iconic American fashion designer Marc Jacobs.

title: Knock Knock
description: Two nubile, stranded women reveal a sinister agenda after they spend the night with a married architect.

title: Conan O'Brien Must Go
description:
S03 E03 — Morocco
Conan forces his follower Yassir to watch the movie synonymous with his hometown, "Casablanca," and promises to get Sona, his podcast co-host, her beloved Moroccan argan oil.

title: The Long Walk
description: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. Everyone's a suspect when Detective Hercule Poirot arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: The Bride!
description: A scientist revives a murdered woman as a companion for a legendary creature. The aftermath defies all expectations.

title: A Killer Story
description:
S01 E01 — Welcome to Topeka
Explores the two-decade-long polarizing murder case of Dana Chandler, accused of a 2002 double homicide, featuring three trials without forensic evidence while examining family conflict and confirmation bias.

title: Dear Ms.: A Revolution in Print
description: A deep dive into the storied and complex legacy of "Ms." magazine through the lens of some of its covers.

title: In the Shadow of the Towers: Stuyvesant High on 9/11
description: Former students from Stuyvesant High School, located near the original World Trade Center in New York City, recall how the harrowing events of Sept. 11 shaped their lives.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E01
As the COVID-19 pandemic ravages New York, Spike Lee shines a light on the city's racial justice activists amid rising police violence.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E02
Spike Lee hears from New York lawmakers who were at the Capitol on January 6; a Queens nurse becomes the U.S.'s first COVID vaccine recipient.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E03
Spike Lee explores the attacks of 9/11, hearing from survivors, frontline workers, and boat captains who launched a historic maritime rescue.

title: NYC Epicenters 9-11-2021
description:
S01 E04
Though the city is united in grief in the wake of 9/11, health problems of first responders, persecution of Sikhs and Muslims underscore the impact of the tragedy; New Yorkers reflect on the hardships the city has faced.

title: Barbie
description: Barbie and Ken are having the time of their lives in the colorful and seemingly perfect world of Barbie Land. However, when they get a chance to go to the real world, they soon discover the joys and perils of living among humans.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E01 — Valerie Gets a New Chapter
Valerie is offered a role on a new multi-camera comedy; stoked that sitcoms are on a comeback, she accepts, but is shocked to discover that the show is being written by artificial intelligence.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E02 — Valerie Has a Secret
Valerie attempts to out-improv the AI script, leading to a breakdown on set.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E03 — Valerie Faces Reality
A leaked clip from Jane's documentary goes viral for all the wrong reasons.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E04 — Valerie Does It All
Valerie Cherish is back; Lisa Kudrow stars as the determined former sitcom star trying to stay relevant in a changing industry filled with AI-written shows.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E05 — Valerie Lights a Candle
Valerie Cherish stars in a sitcom written by artificial intelligence, which presents her with bizarre challenges.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E06 — Valerie's Home Alone
Valerie finds herself alone amid a media meltdown after news of her AI written show is somehow leaked to the public; Val is further shocked to discover that a member of her team has not signed a NDA.

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E07 — Valerie Chases the Truth
Valerie tries to repair the damage caused by negative AI press and save Mark's reality show job by making an appearance on "Finance Dudes."

title: The Comeback
description:
S03 E08 — Valerie Cherish
Urged by NuNet to make a public statement in defense of AI, Valerie contemplates her future with or without How's That?!

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E01 — The Pilot
Teddy, Phil, Lilly, and Ronnie vow to figure out why so many kids have gone missing in Derry; Major Leroy Hanlon arrives at Derry Air Force Base, where he navigates a chilly reception from some of his fellow airmen.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E02 — The Thing in the Dark
Charlotte and Will navigate their new life at the town of Derry; Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E03 — Now You See It
General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission, ordering Leroy and Pauly to escort Dick Hallorann on an aerial search for a new dig site; Rose attends a tribal meeting; Ronnie, Lilly, Will, and Rich attempt to get visual proof by conjuring an Orixá.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E04 — The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
Children encounter frightening situations while Charlotte supports Hank and General Shaw increases pressure.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E05 — 29 Neibolt Street
After learning the truth about General Shaw's operation, Leroy decides to move his family to the base for safety; while the tribal Keepers strategize how to contain increased aggression in town, the military descends on Neibolt Street.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E06 — In the Name of the Father
Plagued by dark visions, Dick gets a surprise at the Black Spot; all the kids face their own challenges.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E07 — The Black Spot
A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long dormant forces; in the aftermath, Dick helps uncover another crucial artifact.

title: IT: Welcome to Derry
description:
S01 E08 — Winter Fire
A dense fog descends upon Derry as General Shaw presses forward with his mission; consequently, the Hanlons join forces with Rose, Dick and the children in a desperate attempt to protect their town.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E01 — Release the Brown Fat
Writer Greg Russo arrives at Ludlow College to support his daughter Katie as her marriage begins to implode.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E02 — Trousers
When Katie's future at Ludlow is thrown into question, Walt offers Greg a deal to keep them both on campus.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E03 — White Whale
Greg navigates his first day as a teacher at Ludlow, Katie deals with being suspended, and Archie assists Sunny in finding an advisor.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E04 — Angry, like an Angry Person
To avoid Walt's party, Greg dedicates himself to a student; with her suspension lifted, Katie considers one-night stands.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E05 — Mr. Razzles
Greg has to deal with his ex-wife visiting the campus; Katie grows closer to Archie and Dylan thrives in his role.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E06 — Cop Hawk
While relishing in his new fling, Greg offers Tommy a place to crash; Katie confronts the student behind some personal campus graffiti; Dylan impresses Walt in her new role; Sunny wrestles with a prestigious job offer.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E07 — All the Dogs' Names
Greg, Cristle, and Tommy attempt a return to normalcy, Archie meets Sunny's father; Walt makes Dylan an unsatisfactory new offer.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E08 — Nobody Spook It
While Greg tries to support an increasingly emotional Katie, Dylan attempts to steer a promising student towards poetry; Sunny is delighted when Archie starts to engage more with her pregnancy.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E09 — Ludlow's Fourth Hottest Professor
Greg motivates the hockey team before a game, Katie focuses on her internship, and Archie gets feedback on his book.

title: Rooster
description:
S01 E10 — Songs for Raisa
After setting boundaries with her parents, Katie makes a decision about her marriage to Archie, who has his own talk with Sunny about the future; then, as he grapples with Katie's independence, Greg prepares to say goodbye to his semester.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E01 — Cornhole
When Clark and Floyd learn that both their marriages have stalled, they begin to explore a new dating app for extramarital affairs.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E02 — Snag It
Detectives Homer and Plumb investigate Clark's affair with Carol and Floyd's use of a dating application.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E03 — The Go Getter
When Detective Plumb discovers that Carol has lied about key details of her affair, she presses Homer to let her question Clark; once in the hot seat, unsettling truths about Clark's relationships with both Floyd and Carol begin to come to light.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E04 — Missouri Mutual Life & Health Insurance Company
A limited series about a love triangle between three adults experiencing middle-age malaise that leads to one of them ending up dead.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E05 — Amphezyne
Floyd confronts Clark about the affair; Plumb and Homer uncover new facts about Carol's past.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E06 — The Denny's Plan
Carol Floyd loses her confidence, so Clark helps her through the DTF app.

title: DTF St. Louis
description:
S01 E07 — No One's Normal. It Just Looks That Way from Across the Street
After a series of revelations, Plumb and Homer question everything they know about the case.
